Family Asteraceae

Common name lettuce
♥Depending on the variety,
lettuce can be a good 
source of folate and a

Lettuce is a salad green that grows in forms ranging from tightly compacted heads
to loose leaves, depending on the variety.  The leaves are pale to dark green or
green with red edges, crisp, and 
mild to pungent.
